description:
OpenFoodJournal is a free, open-source nutrition journal that helps you scan, log, understand, and revisit what you eat. No account, subscription, ads, or tracking are required.

SCAN AND REVIEW
Scan nutrition labels or photograph a meal from multiple angles. OpenFoodJournal estimates calories, macros, and common micronutrients, then shows an editable review before anything is saved. The redesigned camera offers clear Scan Food, Barcode, and Food Label modes with framing that matches the captured photo.

YOUR NUTRITION ASSISTANT
Ask questions grounded in your own journal, Food Bank, goals, and saved research. The persistent Assistant supports tools, web research, images, PDFs, citations, durable sources, context compaction, retry and cancellation controls, and transparent token and usage details. Choose from supported bring-your-own-key providers, including Gemini, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Muse Spark. Research can use model-native search, Tavily, Parallel, or Exa when configured.

A JOURNAL BUILT FOR EVERY DAY
See calories, macros, meals, and selected nutrients at a glance. Navigate with the weekly calendar, review calorie-aware day states, and use optional food images to recognize entries quickly. Customize the app accent and keep the same polished Liquid Glass experience in light or dark mode.

NUTRITION AND HISTORY
Explore day, week, and month trends for calories, macros, and tracked micronutrients. Pin nutrients you care about, open detailed charts, and trace each value back to the foods that contributed it.

FOOD BANK AND SHELF
Save foods you use often, search and organize them, archive older items, manage brands, and log favorites quickly. Mark foods that are available on your Shelf to receive deterministic suggestions based on your goals and current day. Suggestions are calculated on device and remain editable before logging.

BUILD REUSABLE FOODS
Create composite foods from ingredient snapshots or build reusable nutrition calculators for customizable meals. Save prior calculator selections, preserve serving-to-gram conversions, and copy a Journal entry into the Food Bank without changing the nutrition already logged.

TRACK BY WEIGHT
Track a container over time or use an empty-container tare to calculate and immediately log the food you added. Linked Food Bank nutrition and icons carry through the weight-tracking flow.

OPEN FOOD FACTS
Search the public Open Food Facts database for packaged foods and review the result before adding it to your Journal or Food Bank.

APPLE HEALTH
Optionally write supported nutrition values to Apple Health. OpenFoodJournal uses deterministic identifiers and reconciliation so edits replace its own prior samples instead of creating duplicates.

SYNC, BACKUP, AND PRIVACY
Your Journal, Food Bank, goals, and Assistant conversations persist with SwiftData and your private iCloud database. Export spreadsheet CSV files or create a restore-grade JSON backup. Optional Turso mirroring and redacted AI diagnostics are available for users who configure their own database. API keys stay in the iOS Keychain, and AI requests go directly from your device to the provider you choose.

OpenFoodJournal provides nutrition estimates for informational purposes and is not medical advice. Review AI-generated values before saving. Sources and health disclaimers are available in the app.

Built with SwiftUI, SwiftData, CloudKit, and HealthKit. OpenFoodJournal is open source at github.com/kvn8888/OpenFoodJournal.
promotionalText: Our biggest update yet: a redesigned journal, richer nutrition history, a persistent AI assistant, smarter food tools, and more reliable sync.
